signatures.description: Implement a linear-scan register allocator for a Node-hosted RV32 backend: compute live intervals after phi elimination, split intervals at call sites and across loops, honor fixed-register constraints (argument and return ABI pins), and spill using a weighted reload-cost model. The allocator must guarantee that no two simultaneously live virtual registers are assigned the same physical register, including at control-flow join points where intervals partially overlap. For a 2,000-instruction function with 180 virtual registers and 14 allocatable physical registers, produce an allocation whose spill-weighted cost is within 1 percent of the minimum reported by an external integer-programming oracle, and emit a verifier log proving interference correctness.
